|errata_history=This card has one published text. The Virtual Block slip and the Players Committee card image shown here print it.
* '''Original''' (this page): printed in the Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet (official text as of 15 March 2010)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of March 15, 2010"; PDF dated 4 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022213441/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>; the slip ([[:File:VB6-02-Brangus_Glee.png]], slip 3•02) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-brangusglee-pre.gif]]) print it; the Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 5)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> prints the same text. The PC website card list<ref name="cl-1263_2">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11]; the same text in the VMasterType list) (Internet Archive)</ref> shows the same card with the card list's usual notation (icons written out or dropped, quotes as single quotes); that is not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026); it also writes “use 1 force” (lower case) — a capitals/punctuation-only difference, held for the wiki owner's ruling and not made a version. The Virtual Block 6.3 sheet came out on 12 March 2010, three days before the date it carries<ref name="pc-6_3-release">Players Committee home page, news “Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!”, posted 4:40pm Friday, 12 March 2010, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20100409002355/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ 9 April 2010] (Internet Archive); the Players Committee Twitter account wrote on 13 March 2010 that the set “has been released early!” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100721144451/http://twitter.com/swccg Internet Archive copy])</ref>.
